William Shakespeare, Timon of Athens.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-shakespeare/timon-of-athens

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Shakespeare, the author, died 1616 (Wikidata Q692; every death date recorded for this person falls in 1616).

First publication of the text used: 1607 (SE colophon: 'Timon of Athens was published in 1607 by William Shakespeare.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1607, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the text was first published in England (United Kingdom), but the country does not change the result. The last person to die did so in 1616, more than 100 years before 2026. The work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
